warnings.uc_description_permission_denied: Unity Catalog refused to change the description of {{object}} (SELECT and MODIFY permissions, or ownership, needed).
warnings.uc_description_object_not_found: {{object}} was not found in Unity Catalog, or you don't have access to it, so its description was not written there.
warnings.uc_description_user_token_required: The request had no Databricks user token, so the description of {{object}} was not written to Unity Catalog.
warnings.uc_description_no_warehouse: No SQL warehouse is configured, so the description of {{object}} was not written to Unity Catalog.
warnings.uc_description_write_failed: Writing the description of {{object}} to Unity Catalog failed.
warnings.uc_description_import_write_limit: This import reached its limit of {{limit}} rows tried in Unity Catalog, so the description of {{object}} was not written there.
warnings.uc_description_import_writes_failed: The assets were imported, but their descriptions could not be written to Unity Catalog.
warnings.uc_description_existing_comment: Unity Catalog already has another comment on {{object}}, so the description was not written there. Set the description to that comment, or change the comment in Unity Catalog, and save again.
warnings.uc_description_write_unverified: The description of {{object}} was written to Unity Catalog, but the comment could not be read back to check it. Save again to check it.
warnings.uc_description_unsupported_text: The description of {{object}} has a character Unity Catalog can't store, so it was not written there.
warnings.uc_description_import_time_budget: This import ran out of time for Unity Catalog writes, so the description of {{object}} was not written there.
warnings.uc_description_import_writes_uc: The description of {{object}} will be written to Unity Catalog. If it already has a different comment there, that comment is kept and the row gets a warning.
warnings.uc_description_import_replaces_uc: The description of {{object}} will replace its Unity Catalog comment, which is the description Ontos had before.
warnings.uc_description_import_keeps_uc: Unity Catalog has another comment on {{object}}, so the import keeps it and does not write the description there.

descriptionReset.title: Use the Unity Catalog comment as the description
descriptionReset.description: Replaces the description in Ontos with the comment Unity Catalog has on {{object}}.

descriptionReset.ucEmpty: Unity Catalog has no comment on this object, so there is nothing to bring. The Ontos description is kept.
descriptionReset.replaceNote: The previous description is kept in the change log.
